scope: Outstation journey: HOME Outstation form (TC_HOME_028-032) + Outstation paths through LOC, TRIP, VLIST, VDET (TC_VDET_007), CONF, INQ incl. Confirm, Inquiry Details, Cancel Trip; gap exploration
executedBy: Claude Code (App Live via Claude in Chrome)

credentials.method: Entered manually on device by the user; values from .env (BANNI_QA_PHONE / BANNI_QA_PASSWORD) - not seen or logged by Claude

approvals.text: User approved (chat, 2026-10-01): complete Outstation flow incl. inquiry Confirm, Inquiry Details, Cancel Trip and other applicable actions; payment not integrated in build - attempt where possible and record Fail/Blocked. Claude will not enter card/UPI/bank details. New genuine Outstation cases pre-approved for CSV/XLSX.

environmentNotes: Test data created and cleaned up: Outstation inquiries 520 (Majestic->Mysuru, 4-7 Oct), 521 (Majestic->Mysuru->Madikeri, drop Mangaluru, 4-6 Oct) and 522 (Majestic->Panaji, 6 Oct-5 Nov) were submitted with user approval and all cancelled (cancellation invoices INV-56, INV-57, INV-58). No payments were made; payment gateway returned an error for every attempt.

Environment: the Chrome window hosting App Live was minimised/covered three times early in the run (2 recovery events, fullscreen restore). Later the user docked the window at ~500px width on the right; the device stream (234x519) stayed fully usable, so coordinates were recomputed from the viewport probe before each step. App Live network throttling (Offline Mode) restarted the stream but kept the session and app state.

cases.actual: Outstation tab shows Pickup Location (Select Pickup Location), Pickup Date & Time (today 01-10-2026, current time 05:57 am), Destination > First Destination * (Search Destination 1 Location), + Add Another Destination, Drop Date & Time (empty dd/mm/yyyy and --:--), Number of Passengers (1), Additional Options > Different drop location toggle, Search Vehicles. No Number of Hours and no Multi-day trip toggle.
cases.notes: Only First Destination carries the * marker although Pickup and Drop date are also mandatory (minor UI inconsistency).

cases.notes: Drop date error uses generic wording 'This field is required' (others are field-specific); no separate highlight on drop time.

cases.actual: + Add Another Destination adds 'Destination 2' (Search Destination 2 Location) with a trash icon; trash removes it. Fields added after a failed search immediately show 'Destination location is required'.

cases.expected: Only additional destinations have a delete icon; First Destination always remains

Added destinations up to Destination 11 with no limit, message or disabled state; each new field is numbered sequentially and the form stays usable (scrolls). No maximum is enforced.
cases.notes: Deleting from the top (Destination 2 repeatedly) renumbers the remaining fields correctly.

Pickup 04-10-2026 10:30 am, drop 01-10-2026 06:30 am -> 'Drop date & time must be after pickup date & time'; Search Vehicles blocked. Outstation Trip tab 'Outstation Pricing - Daily minimum and distance-based estimate': Base Rate (Driver, Fuel, Day Allowance) Rs 16,500; Bata Cost (Before 6am or After 10pm) Rs 1,000; Bata Cost (Before 10pm or After 6am) Rs 1,000; Toll & Parking Actuals; GST Additional; note 'Toll & parking are actuals. GST is additional...'. No per-km line and no daily minimum km although the card says '+ Rs 55/km' (OBS-14 persists); second bata label describes daytime hours (as in TC_VDET_009).

cases.expected: Base cost x 4 days and/or km charge per the outstation rate; only applicable bata; total = sum of lines and equals list price
cases.actual: Vehicle Base Cost Rs 16,500 (one day), Bata (before 6am/after 10pm) Rs 1,000, Bata (before 10pm/after 6am) Rs 1,000, Estimated Grand Total Rs 18,500. No x4 days, no km charge (1200 km x Rs 55 = Rs 66,000), night bata applied for a 10:30 am pickup. List card showed Rs 73,000.

Outstation Confirm Your Trip modal: route map, Customer Details (masked), Selected Vehicles '33 Seater Deluxe Coach - 1', Route Summary 'Outstation' with Pickup and Dropoff, Dates 4,5,6,7 Oct 2026, 20 Passengers, Estimated Trip Cost, note, Edit Inquiry and Confirm.

cases.actual: Single Confirm tap (approved; stale-frame guard passed) -> 'Inquiry Submitted Successfully!' with 'We're calculating the most accurate price for your trip', Estimated Cost (Approx.) Rs 18,500, Track My Inquiry and Back to Home. Inquiry ID 520 created.
Track My Inquiry opens Ride > My Bookings (Today filter, Live tab).
New inquiry (trip 4 Oct) absent from Today (Inquired 6 unchanged); Week > Inquired shows 12 with the new Outstation card on top.

Inquired card: 'OutStation' badge, 'inquired' chip, rating 0.00, route Majestic -> Agrahara, Chamrajpura, Mysuru, 4 days, 1200 km, 35 seats, 20 pax, 33 Seater Deluxe Coach, Starts From Rs 18,500, View Details.

Status chip reads 'inquired' (lowercase) while the tab reads 'Inquired'; trip badge 'OutStation' (mixed case).
View Details opens Inquiry Details with 'Inquiry ID: 520'.

Inquiry 520: 'OutStation Trip', Majestic -> Distance 1200 km -> Agrahara, Chamrajpura, Mysuru; Schedule Date 4,5,6,7 Oct 2026, Pickup 10:30 am, 'Expected arrival: 06:30 am'; Total Amount Rs18500; Payment Information (Advance Received Rs0, Invoice Not generated yet, Payment amount 500, gateway Razorpay / Cashfree, Pay Advance); Cancel Trip.

cases.scenario: Outstation inquiry schedule shows return date and time clearly
cases.preconditions: Outstation inquiry 4-7 Oct, pickup 10:30 am, drop 07-10 06:30 am
cases.steps: 1. Open Inquiry Details 2. Read Schedule
cases.expected: Schedule shows pickup date/time and return/drop date/time (e.g. 'Return: 07 Oct, 06:30 am')
cases.actual: Schedule shows 'Expected arrival: 06:30 am' with no date - reads as arriving before the 10:30 am pickup; return date 07 Oct is not stated.
Inquiry 520 Payment Information: Advance Received Rs0, Invoice Status 'Not generated yet', Payment amount default 500, gateway Razorpay selected by default, Pay Advance button.
cases.notes: A second gateway option 'Cashfree' is now offered (not in the baseline expectation).

cases.actual: 0 -> dialog 'Invalid Amount - Please enter a valid amount to pay.' (correct). 20000 (> total Rs18,500) is NOT rejected client-side - request is sent and the backend returns 'Payment Error - "gateway" is not allowed field'. No minimum/maximum rule communicated.
'500-' and 'abc' (typed via keyboard injection; the on-screen keypad is numeric) are accepted in the field but rejected on Pay Advance with 'Invalid Amount - Please enter a valid amount to pay.'
cases.notes: Field itself accepts '-' and letters; validation happens only on submit.

cases.actual: Pay Advance with valid amount 500 and Razorpay -> dialog 'Payment Error - "gateway" is not allowed field'; same with Cashfree. Payment gateway never opens; Advance Received stays Rs0. Payment is not integrated in this build (per user) and the raw backend validation message is shown to the user.
Cannot reach the gateway to cancel or fail a payment - Pay Advance returns 'Payment Error - "gateway" is not allowed field' for both gateways.
Back arrow on Inquiry Details returns to My Bookings with Week filter and Inquired tab still selected (count 12).

Cancel Trip opens 'Cancel Booking & Process Refund' (Inquiry ID 520, refund calculation, optional reason, Back / Confirm Cancellation). Back closes the dialog; inquiry unchanged (status, Total Rs18500, Cancel Trip still available).

Approved. Reason entered, Confirm Cancellation (single tap, stale-frame guard passed) -> 'Booking Cancelled (Inquiry #520)' with Refund Summary and Cancellation Invoice INV-56; Close returns to My Bookings > Week > Inquired, count 12 -> 11 and the Outstation card removed.
cases.notes: There is no Cancelled tab/filter, so the cancelled inquiry and its invoice cannot be viewed afterwards (see TC_BOOK_011).

cases.scenario: Cancellation refund for an inquiry with no advance paid
cases.preconditions: Outstation inquiry with Advance Received Rs0 (no payment), trip > 3 days away
cases.steps: 1. Open Inquiry Details 2. Tap Cancel Trip 3. Review Refund Calculation 4. Confirm Cancellation
cases.testData: Inquiry 520, trip cost Rs18,500, advance Rs0
cases.expected: Refund amount = amount actually paid (Rs0) minus penalty (no negative/positive refund); no refund invoice for an unpaid inquiry
cases.actual: Refund Calculation: Trip cost Rs18,500, One day charge Rs9,500, Penalty 10%, Penalty retained Rs1,850, Refund amount Rs16,650 (3 days 4 hours before start, slab 3d<=T<7d). After confirm: Cancellation Invoice INV-56 with Penalty Rs1,850 and Refund Rs16,650 although nothing was paid. 'One day charge Rs9,500' matches neither the Rs16,500/day rate nor the trip cost.

cases.scenario: Cancellation penalty slab under 3 days before trip
cases.preconditions: Inquiry with trip start 24h-3 days away (Inquiry 521, start 04-10 06:31 am)

cases.notes: Slab arithmetic is consistent; refund on an unpaid inquiry is tracked under BUG-OUT-014.

App Live Throttle Network > Offline Mode with the Confirm modal open (31-day Majestic -> Panaji trip). Confirm -> dialog "Siddaganga Travels - No internet connection"; modal stays open, no inquiry created.
